name: Agentio
description: The Agentio connector brings your Agentio reporting into Claude. Ask for your Creator advertising performance in plain language and get the numbers back with the definitions behind them, so a question like "what did we pay per conversion last quarter?" is answered rather than assembled from a report. Ask which Creators drove the most engagement this quarter, how cost per acquisition changed month over month, how a campaign's reach is holding up week to week, or how a 30-day view is counted.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Agentio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Agentio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.agentio.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Agentio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agentio provides these MCP tools: call_api, list_operations, read_product_doc, and search_product_docs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Agentio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Agentio in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Agentio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Agentio is developed by Agentio. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
